charter.title: Story Charter
charter.subtitle: What you asked for, in one place. Fixed requirements, deliberately open choices and content boundaries are sent to every planning and chapter prompt for the whole novel.
charter.saved: Charter saved. Every future plan and chapter will receive it.
charter.briefChanged: The brief changed since it was last interpreted. Interpret again to refresh the inferred entries (your own entries are kept).
charter.briefHint: Describe the novel in as much or as little detail as you like. This text is never rewritten by the system.
charter.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. adult readers of Korean-style progression fantasy
charter.briefPlaceholder: A short idea or pages of requirements: protagonist, world, progression, relationships, tone, themes, structure, content boundaries, length, ending — and what you deliberately want to leave open.
charter.interpretHint: One model call turns the brief into requirements, open choices and boundaries you can edit. Entries it adds are marked “inferred”.
charter.interpreted: Brief interpreted: {n} inferred requirement(s) added. Review them below.
charter.questionsHint: Answer any of these by adding a requirement or an open choice; none of them block generation.
charter.requirementsHint: Fixed requirements outrank the outline and the reference; preferences guide choices.
charter.requirementPlaceholder: e.g. The protagonist is a former court accountant who never uses violence first
charter.noRequirements: No requirements yet. Add one, or interpret your brief.

sourceHint.author: You wrote this. The system never rewrites it.
sourceHint.interpreted: Inferred from your brief. Edit it to make it yours, or delete it.
sourceHint.imported: Imported from the Create Novel form.

charter.openChoicesHint: Things you have not decided. The system will not turn them into permanent facts unless you allow it.
charter.openTopicPlaceholder: e.g. whether the mentor survives the first arc
charter.openGuidancePlaceholder: Optional guidance: how the story may explore it without settling it
charter.noOpenChoices: Nothing marked open. Everything not listed here may be decided by the planner.
charter.boundariesHint: Content the novel must not include. Hard boundaries block a chapter; soft ones are avoided.
charter.boundaryPlaceholder: e.g. No sexual content; no love triangle
charter.previewHint: The exact charter block sent to each kind of prompt (scope-filtered).
charter.previewSaveFirst: Save the charter to preview what the AI receives.
charter.previewEmpty: Empty: nothing is sent until the charter has entries.
